description.en: Self-hosted monitoring for websites, ports, mail servers and certificates, with a MariaDB database and email alerts through the cluster smarthost.
description.fr: Supervision auto-hébergée des sites web, ports, serveurs de messagerie et certificats, avec une base MariaDB et des alertes par email via le smarthost du cluster.
description.it: Monitoraggio self-hosted di siti web, porte, server di posta e certificati, con un database MariaDB e avvisi email tramite lo smarthost del cluster.
